General.Description:
Seven kilometres below the surface of the Pacific Ocean lies a place humans were never meant to reach. Dr. Harriet Voss and her three-person crew aboard the research submersible Leviathan II are about to find out why.

Hired by a private oceanographic foundation to survey an unmapped section of the Mariana Trench, the team descends into one of the last unexplored frontiers on Earth. What they discover — a vast geological cavity sealed off from the rest of the ocean by a thin membrane of basalt — is the find of the century. What is living inside it may be the discovery of the millennium.

Into the Abyss is a sweeping adventure novel that combines the rigorous scientific authenticity of natural history writing with the claustrophobic tension of a deep-sea survival thriller. Tobias Crane spent two years consulting with marine biologists and submersible engineers to create a world that feels utterly real, even as it becomes increasingly terrifying.

With oxygen running low, communications severed, and no prospect of rescue at this depth, Voss and her crew must make an impossible choice: surface immediately and abandon the discovery of a lifetime, or stay long enough to understand what they have found — and whether it wants them to leave.

An unforgettable descent into the unknown.
